task.title: R1B: one write coordinator per resolved store folder
task.objective: Execute R1B only by giving every JsonProfileStore instance that resolves to the same storage folder a single shared write-coordination authority, eliminating the characterized same-folder stale-snapshot race without changing persisted shapes, atomic replacement, failure isolation, configured-path switching, report persistence, offline behavior or the existing store factories.

architecture: R1B only: do not begin R2 execution IPC decomposition or any later refactoring phase.
Introduce no new persistence architecture, database, repository framework, queue system or replacement store; the coordinator is a serialization authority only.
Establish exactly one write-coordination authority per resolved storage folder, shared across independently constructed store instances.
Different resolved folders must remain independently writable and must not be unnecessarily serialized.
Avoid global singleton state that prevents safe configured-path changes or isolated tests; coordination must be keyed by resolved folder and must not outlive its pending work.
src/storage/ProfileStore.ts imports src/storage/atomicReplace.ts directly; the app/main/atomicReplace.ts re-export stays for existing main callers.
Existing store factory signatures and per-call path resolution stay unchanged so callers can migrate later.
security: No change to sender authorization, licensing checkpoints, protected-login handoff, secret masking or app-owned session profiles.
No new process-wide mutable state that a lower-privileged caller could use to observe or block another caller's writes.
compatibility: Preserve atomic temp-file plus replace behavior, current JSON shapes, legacy-profile compatibility, unknown fields where the owning schema permits them, failure isolation, configured Settings path switching and report persistence behavior.
A write failure such as ENOSPC must not permanently poison the coordinator; later valid writes to the same folder must still succeed.
Atomic replacement must still leave valid complete JSON and no orphan temp files, and corrupt-file quarantine plus pretty-print behavior are unchanged.
Save/reload, edit/re-save, import/export, reports and legacy fixtures remain compatible.
offline: No runtime network dependency, new dependency, resource-path change, global runtime dependency, or mutable write under resources/ or app.asar; non-admin operation preserved.

acceptance.description: Independently created store instances resolving to the same folder share one write-coordination boundary with no overlapping mutation or replace critical sections, while different resolved folders keep independent concurrency and no global singleton blocks path changes or tests.

The characterized same-folder stale-snapshot lost-update race is eliminated or explicitly bounded by existing store semantics, and negative/mutation controls fail if independent per-instance queues are restored.

Atomic replacement, failure isolation, JSON/profile/report formats, legacy fixtures, unknown-field handling, configured-path switching and runner behavior are unchanged, with strict offline and source hygiene green.
Beads, validation ledger, assignments, plans and AI state record current evidence; the roadmap Overview reads Sources agree; coherent commits are pushed to main with AWTKIT.rar preserved.
